Membership Renewals & Direct Debit Collection

Both run for every club — pause a club that is not ready

Automatic renewals are switched OFF for every club (MEMBERSHIP_RENEWALS_DISABLED in the server configuration). Nobody is charged or sent a renewal e-mail until it is removed — the pauses below apply once it is.
The Direct Debit collection is switched OFF for every club (DD_COLLECTION_DISABLED in the server configuration). No queued invoice is collected until it is removed — earlier unconfirmed collections are still checked with GoCardless. The collection pauses below apply once it is.
The Direct Debit collection tables are not migrated yet — nothing is collected until the migrations have run.
The database is not migrated yet — renewals do not run, and clubs cannot be paused, until the migrations have run.

How it works

Members with automatic renewal on, on a paid monthly / quarterly / annual membership

Running: each member is e-mailed the amount and the date at least the club's reminder days before anything is taken (Direct Debit or card), and charged from 7 days before their membership ends — never after it has ended. Someone who can no longer be told in time is asked to renew by hand.

Paused: nobody in the club is charged or renewed automatically. Members whose membership would have renewed are e-mailed that it will not renew automatically (and the club's digest lists them). A member already told "it renews" and then "it will not" is not charged for that period even if you resume.

Direct Debit collection (a separate switch): on the club's billing day every invoice queued for Direct Debit is collected — one GoCardless payment per member, however old the invoices. An invoice that matches a GoCardless payment not linked to any invoice is held (never collected) until the club links, releases or voids it. Paused: nothing is collected for the club; its queued invoices wait (and are all collected at the first billing day after you resume).
